notes.title: Update 1.2.1
notes.notes:
First post-launch update, I really appreciate the feedback <3

Changes:

Fixed translation of the word "Exit" in the Prestige menu
Added the option to exit the Shop, Chest and Prestige menu by pressing ESC ("now the dog doesn't escape me haha")
Fixed a bug where the amount of coins appeared fractional instead of integer number
Updated the SteamWorks version and the way it counts achievements, hopefully the captured Dogs and Rats achievements will work correctly now.



Any Feedback or Suggestions we will be grateful to hear on our Discord.

notes.title: End of Demo Version
notes.notes:
The King Cat Clicker Demo will be removed on November 30, 2024, we are approaching the official launch date which will be in January, 2025, so we decided to remove the Demo version from the Store.

Enjoy of the Demo until the end of November!

notes.title: Update 1.1.4
notes.notes:
Changed the Game format, From Nwjs to WebView2
Total game size from 200mb to less than 20mb
When you open the game for the first time, it will start in your Steam language.
Discord button now uses Steam Overlay
Now the game saves in the Documents folder and uses only one lightweight file, drastic improvement in the use of the Steam Cloud

notes.title: Demo Version Update
notes.notes:
Demo Version Update

We are proud to announce a new update to the Demo version, we believe these are important improvements and will bring us closer to the final version of the game.

Play and share your experience, we will be happy to hear your opinion.

notes.title: Demo Version Now Available
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the Demo version of The King Cat Clicker

There are still many improvements and content to be introduced in the final version of the game, but this Demo version already allows for greater feedback collection and I encourage you to participate in these tests and give your opinion on the current state of the game.

The Demo version already has all 27 promised languages.
